title: Cross-plane retry translation and hosted 5xx mitigation
creator: Ava Patel
description: Several enterprise customers escalated repeated 5xx spikes and timeouts observed in the Hosted Inference API during tenant surges. Post-incident analysis shows a mismatch in retry semantics between client SDKs (various versions) and our frontdoor/router layer: retries are being replayed multiple times across frontdoor->proxy->runtime, leading to request amplification, KV cache thrashing, long tail latencies, and downstream GPU queue saturation. This ticket coordinates a short-term mitigation and a robust cross-plane fix that translates/normalizes retry semantics at the boundary, prevents duplicate work, and restores stable SLOs.
impact_summary: Customer-visible errors: 5xx rate increased from baseline 0.2% to 4.7% for affected tenants during surges; median P95 latency rose from 350ms to 1.8s. Top three impacted customers reported production errors (two with business-critical SLAs). Correlated signals: KV cache eviction rate +120%, GPU queue length spikes, and a 3x increase in inferred idempotent operation duplicates.
reproduction_steps: 1) Use SDK v2.1.0 and v2.4.3 concurrently to send 50 concurrent requests/tenant with per-request retry enabled (default SDK behavior).
2) Target a model route that triggers longer compute (seq_len ~ 2048) to exercise KV cache and GPU queueing.
3) Simulate network jitter (250-500ms) to provoke client-side retries; observe frontdoor logs and runtime tracing for duplicate request IDs.
4) Verify KV cache eviction metrics and per-tenant 5xx spikes in the telemetry dashboard.
proposed_solution:
Short-term (mitigation, 48-72h):
     - Introduce a translation shim at frontdoor that normalizes common SDK retry headers into a single canonical Retry-Count and Idempotency-Token header.

Medium-term (2-3 sprints):
     - Implement per-tenant request fingerprinting and deduplication at the proxy layer (idempotency token + request hash) to drop replays that would re-execute expensive runtime work.

Long-term (Q2):
     - Add adaptive ingress admission control backed by a token bucket per-tenant with backpressure signals to clients (429/Retry-After) when downstream GPU queue saturation is detected.

Additional safety:
     - Ensure the runtime honors the normalized headers and never double-executes non-idempotent actions without explicit idempotency tokens.

Observability:
     - Emit a new metric tenant_request_replay_detected{route,tenant} and trace annotations for dedup decisions.
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy frontdoor translation shim as a config-guarded feature flag (ff:retry_translation) to 10% edge nodes for 24h rollout.
2) Monitor replay and 5xx metrics; if improvement >= 60% reduction in deduplicated 5xx, expand to 50% for another 24h.
3) Enable across all edge nodes and start proxy dedup service in canary mode for a small set of low-risk tenants.
4) Full rollout to all tenants after 72h stable metric windows and runbook signoff.
test_plan: Unit tests for header translation logic with combinations of existing SDK headers.
Integration tests that replay identical request payloads and confirm single execution at the runtime (assert backend exec-count == 1).
Chaos test: introduce packet loss/jitter in lab to confirm dedup and backpressure behavior does not cause data loss for idempotent ops.
Smoke: run canary tenants through production-like load generator to validate latency and 5xx improvement.
telemetry_queries: SQL: SELECT tenant, count(*) as replayed FROM request_log WHERE duplicate_detected = true AND ts > now() - interval '1 day' GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY replayed DESC LIMIT 10;
Trace query: trace where tag"dedup_action" == "accepted" or "dropped" and duration > 200ms
comments: 2025-03-03 - Ava Patel: Initial report from SE about three enterprise customers showing repeat 5xx during weekday morning surge. Triage found mixed SDK versions and no global canonical idempotency header in requests.

2025-03-04 - Diego Morales: Reproduced in staging with SDK v2.1.0 client; observed duplicated requests with new internal request_id on each hop. KV cache eviction skyrockets. Spiking a quick fix: flag to reject requests missing an idempotency header if retry_count > 2.

2025-03-05 - SRE (Maya Chen): Implemented temporary rate-limiter per-tenant in edge layer and reverted noisy default SDK retry to conservative for affected tenants. Early signal: 30% reduction in 5xx for canary tenants.

2025-03-06 - Design Review (Roche): Concern about breaking clients that rely on client-side retry semantics. Decided translation shim should be non-breaking and preserve existing headers in canonical form.
2025-03-07 - Diego Morales: Draft PR opened for frontdoor header translation (PR #1426). Adding unit tests and integration harness. Planning canary rollout next week.
2025-03-10 - PM (Lina Gomez): Customer comms prepared; sending staged advisory to affected customers explaining mitigation and upcoming durable fix.
acceptance_criteria: Observed 60%+ reduction in deduplicated 5xx rate for affected tenants during simulated surges in staging.
No increase in client-visible errors for tenants without retries enabled (backwards compatibility validated).
New metrics and traces emitted and surfaced on console for per-tenant replay/dedup counts.
Canary rollout completed with runbook signoff and customer comms ready.
